name: LdarSurveyRepairManager
tagline: Every leak tagged, repaired and verified on time – OGI/AVO/Method 21 survey schedule, repair deadlines, delay of repair and surveyor certification in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete LDAR app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: plan surveys per site and frequency, tag leaks found with OGI, AVO or Method 21, drive each leak through first attempt, final repair, delay of repair and re-survey verification against configurable deadlines, keep OGI and Method 21 surveyor certification current and see every deadline on a compliance calendar.
features: 8 KPI tiles incl. overdue first attempts and repairs, surveys overdue and on-time repair %
First attempt, final repair and re-survey deadlines with Due soon / Overdue flags
Delay of repair with reason, end date and justification; expired DOR flagged
Re-survey verification with Method 21 leak definition check
Survey schedule by site type frequency with site history
Compliance calendar (month grid and phone agenda)
Surveyor certification check blocks records after expiry
Bulk first attempt / repaired / verified, CSV export, delete with undo
Demo mode with 13 fictional sites and 12 months of surveys
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set LdarSurveyRepairManager + field LdarSurveyRepairManagerPortal)
